items.source: Uses of ZipContent.Kind in org.springframework.boot.loader.zip
items.translation: `org.springframework.boot.loader.zip` 包中 ZipContent.Kind` 的用法

items.source:
Provides low-level support for handling zip content, including support for nested and
virtual zip files.
items.translation: 提供处理 zip 内容的低级支持，包括对嵌套和虚拟 zip 文件的支持。

items.source: Return the kind of content that was loaded.
Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
